source_caption:
In 1931, Charlie “Lucky” Luciano reshaped the American Mafia by abolishing the “boss of bosses” system and establishing the Commission to govern New York’s Five Families: Genovese, Lucchese, Gambino, Bonanno, and Profaci (later Colombo). Luciano himself became the first boss of what would become the modern Genovese crime family.⁣⁣⁣
⁣⁣⁣
You can watch Luciano’s story from the very beginning in 𝐁𝐨𝐚𝐫𝐝𝐰𝐚𝐥𝐤 𝐄𝐦𝐩𝐢𝐫𝐞 which takes you back to the Prohibition era, following Luciano’s rise and the foundations of the modern American Mafia. ⁣⁣⁣
⁣⁣⁣
𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐆𝐨𝐝𝐟𝐚𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 brings us into the fictional world of the Corleone family, drawing inspiration from the powerful Gambino family. ⁣⁣⁣
⁣⁣⁣
𝐆𝐨𝐨𝐝𝐟𝐞𝐥𝐥𝐚𝐬 tells the true story of Henry Hill and his associates, who operated within the real-life Lucchese crime family. ⁣⁣⁣
⁣⁣⁣
𝐃𝐨𝐧𝐧𝐢𝐞 𝐁𝐫𝐚𝐬𝐜𝐨 follows undercover FBI agent Joseph Pistone as he infiltrates the Bonanno crime family, exposing the inner workings of organized crime. ⁣⁣⁣
⁣⁣⁣
Finally, 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐒𝐨𝐩𝐫𝐚𝐧𝐨𝐬 explores the fictional DiMeo crime family in New Jersey and its relationship with New York’s Lupertazzi family, a fictional organization inspired by the Colombo (earlier: Profaci) family.
